name: Get enabled event channels
description: Call this when you need to know which contact event channels are enabled for the account before reading or filtering event-based activity, so you can skip channels the account does not have. It returns only the channel identifiers; to get the filter definitions available for a contact's timeline use contacts.list_timeline_event_filters, and to read a contact's actual web activity use contacts.get_contact_visited_webpages.
preconditions: The caller must be authenticated as a user of the Brevo account.

data.description: Identifiers of the event channels enabled for the account. Observed values contained only "email".
